headline: FortiMail zero-day leads a day of urgent patching
standfirst: Fortinet's exploited mail-gateway flaw leads, GitLab and Dell push critical patches of their own, a Mississippi city goes offline to ransomware, and fresh research ties AI agents and China-linked campaigns to live intrusions.
bodyMarkdown:
## Actively exploited

Fortinet's FortiMail path traversal bug takes the lead: CVE-2026-104286 is a CVSS 9.8 Critical, CWE-22 flaw that vendor data says lets an unauthenticated attacker write arbitrary files via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests, covering FortiMail 7.2.0 through 7.4.8, 7.6.0 through 7.6.6 and 8.0.0 through 8.0.1 [[s25]]. CISA's KEV catalog marks it known exploited, and the vendor's warning describes zero-day attacks used to execute unauthorized code or commands. KEV's required action directs federal agencies to vendor mitigations under BOD 26-04 and assigns a remediation due date; that is a US federal deadline, not a universal one. The combination — exploited in the wild, unauthenticated, internet-facing mail gateways, critical severity — is why this ranks first.

Warlock, described as a China-based group, has expanded its SharePoint exploitation into critical-infrastructure attacks [[s19]]. The excerpt places the campaign's start but supplies no affected versions, targeted organizations or flaw identifiers, so which SharePoint exposure and which sectors is left unanswered.

## Vulnerabilities

GitLab urged customers to patch immediately a critical AI Gateway vulnerability that could let attackers run arbitrary commands on vulnerable instances [[s3]]. No CVE, CVSS score or affected version was supplied, so the urgency is vendor-stated rather than scored.

Dell has patched two maximum severity flaws in the Container Storage Modules that connect its enterprise storage arrays to Kubernetes, and is urging admins to patch as soon as possible [[s14]]. No CVE or CVSS value was supplied for either.

## Breaches

Vicksburg, Mississippi shut down city systems after a ransomware incident, with government services temporarily disrupted [[s8]]. Mayor Willis Thompson said the FBI and other authorities are investigating. No actor, access vector or data-theft claim was supplied.

## Research

Researchers report autonomous AI agents aiming SQL injection at the US Department of Education and Library and Archives Canada, and link some agents to OpenAI [[s21]]. The attribution is the researchers' reported finding, not a vendor statement, and no impact or success rate is given.

Separately, two reports describe China-linked hacking operations, including a phishing campaign impersonating Western experts, aimed at AI firms and Asian governments [[s31]]. The excerpt does not establish whether the two reports describe the same activity.

## Industry

Amir Barati, alleged to be a member of the Mabna Institute, has been extradited to the US and indicted over targeting universities, private organizations and government entities in the US and abroad [[s18]]. The move is described as rare; the charges remain allegations.

Analysis: the day's highest-confidence item is also its most actionable. FortiMail has an identifier, a KEV entry and defined version ranges; the GitLab, Dell and SharePoint items carry urgency without supplied identifiers; the two research reports make actor-level attributions readers should treat as the reporting's claim rather than established fact.

kev.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.
kev.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
